subject: Private maintenance sync: version freeze, network drain, rollback rehearsals
messages:
From: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@medicarex.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming Private cluster maintenance & audit window

Hi Aisha,

We have our quarterly compliance window coming up in mid-April and MedicareX needs a clear plan for the Private deployment upgrade you proposed. Specifically we need:

- A version-freeze policy and a clear pin/unpin flow (we can't accept in-flight auto-rolls during the audit).
- Network drain steps and expected connection churn (BGP, LB, and any host-level cordon).
- KV cache behavior during rolling restarts and whether warm restarts preserve session affinity.
- Rollback rehearsal steps and time-to-fallback SLA we can include in our audit evidence.
- Any required maintenance windows and suggested blackout windows for our users.

Can you provide a concise runbook and proposed maintenance date(s)? SOC 2 auditors will likely ask for the rollback rehearsal evidence, so we'd prefer a rehearsal before the primary maintenance.

Thanks,
Carlos Vega
Head of Infra Ops
MedicareX
(ops-infra@medicarex.com)

(Attachment: none yet)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@medicarex.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming Private cluster maintenance & audit window

Carlos,

Thanks for the note — we can absolutely support the audit requirements. I put together a targeted plan and attached the maintenance-runbook-v1.pdf + changelog-2027-04.yaml for your review. High-level summary below; see the runbook for step-by-step commands and preflight checks.

Planned approach (summary):
- Version pinning: We'll create a pinned release tag for your fleet (pin v2027-04-rc1). Customers on pin will not receive automatic model/agent updates. Pin/unpin controlled via your Private Console; unpin requires an explicit approval commit.
- Maintenance windows: Proposed primary window: Sat 2027-04-17 02:00-06:00 PT. Rehearsal: Sat 2027-04-10 02:00-04:00 PT (non-peak, subset canary only).
- Canary and staged rollout: 5% canary -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%, with health gates at each stage.
- Network drain: Host cordon -> graceful session drain at LB -> BGP route withdraw for the host group -> verify zero active token write ops -> decommission. Estimated extra connection churn: up to 120s per connection depending on client retries.
- KV cache & session warmups: KV persistence is enabled; we will snapshot hot KV shards before draining and warm the cache as nodes return to service. Session affinity will be preserved for pinned versions; ephemeral sessions may re-auth.
- Rollback: Immediate rollback to pinned variant can be executed within our SLO of 8 minutes for a staged rollback (this includes cache resync). Full fleet rollback (100%) window targeted under 25 minutes; rehearsals will validate.
- Audit artifacts: Runbook, canary logs, teardown logs, and signed rollback confirmation will be uploaded to the drive link below after the rehearsal.

Action items for MedicareX:
1) Confirm rehearsal + primary window dates above (or propose alternatives within mid-April).
2) Confirm point-of-contact for post-mortem (we'll include your auditor contact if you prefer evidence upload directly).
3) Approve the attached runbook for the rehearsal.

Attachments: maintenance-runbook-v1.pdf (detailed runbook), changelog-2027-04.yaml

I'll coordinate an internal dry-run with Laura and Marissa to validate the network drain scripts before the rehearsal.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Engineer, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: maintenance-runbook-v1.pdf, changelog-2027-04.yaml)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@medicarex.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming Private cluster maintenance & audit window

Aisha — forwarding a quick ops checklist from my dry run. Quoting your proposed windows below and adding technical notes.

On Fri, Apr 2, 2027 at 10:45 AM Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Planned approach (summary):
> - Version pinning: We'll create a pinned release tag for your fleet (pin v2027-04-rc1).
> - Maintenance windows: Proposed primary window: Sat 2027-04-17 02:00-06:00 PT. Rehearsal: Sat 2027-04-10 02:00-04:00 PT.

Marissa's ops notes (dry-run results):
- Drain ordering: 1) Pause acceptance at LB, 2) Soft cordon (no new tasks), 3) Migrate leader leases, 4) BGP withdraw host prefixes, 5) Wait 3x heartbeat intervals then terminate.
- Script: drain-script.sh will perform the above and emit a canary-health.json every 30s; sample attached (Attachment: drain-script.sh).
- Cache snapshot: Use /opt/redwood/kv/snapshot --consistent flag; snapshots stored on your S3-backed NFS. Verify checksum before node restart.
- Rehearsal scope: Do rehearsal on three non-critical availability zones first. If green, expand to canary group (5% of capacity).
- Rollback trigger rules documented in runbook: failed health-checks > 2 consecutive intervals OR error-rate > 1% for 5 mins triggers auto-abort and rollback.

I'll be online for the rehearsal and will publish the dry-run logs to the drive folder.

—Marissa
Staff Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: drain-script.sh)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming Private cluster maintenance & audit window

Carlos,

Following up to confirm dates and next steps. MedicareX requested the rehearsal evidence for the auditor — we'll run the rehearsal on Sat 2027-04-10 02:00-04:00 PT (canary-only) and the primary maintenance on Sat 2027-04-17 02:00-06:00 PT as proposed unless you instruct otherwise.

Plan for the rehearsal:
- Preflight checklist (to complete by Thu 2027-04-08): verify snapshots, confirm POC on your side, ensure firewall rules allow the rescue route.
- During rehearsal: Marissa will run drain-script.sh for AZ-a subset only; we'll collect canary-health.json, system logs, and rollback timing.
- Post rehearsal: we'll upload artifacts and a signed rollback confirmation to the Drive link and notify your auditor with the HubSpot ticket reference.

If you approve the windows, please reply with "APPROVE: rehearsal & primary 2027-04-10, 2027-04-17" and we will open the DocuSign approval for your legal team.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn here.

Best regards,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Engineer, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
